title: Yber
description: Gamified, neuroinclusive education platform empowering the next generation to develop and practice social skills and build real projects for the future job market. Scaled and deployed through a partnership with Chandler Unified School District (40,000+ students), powered by a multi-layer agentic architecture that autonomously grades student submissions, delivers precise feedback, creates lessons, and announces student milestones on social media.
bullets: Scaled and deployed through a partnership with Chandler Unified School District (40,000+ students).
Built a multi-layer agentic architecture that autonomously grades student submissions, delivers feedback, creates lessons, and announces milestones on social media.

title: ShelfSmart
summary: AI inventory hardware that cuts restaurant food waste.
description: Lightweight, AI-powered hardware + software ecosystem for automated restaurant inventory tracking. Real-time predictive forecasting models designed to cut food waste by an estimated 40% and combat $3B in annual industry losses—reducing manual labor, eliminating human ordering errors, and protecting venue profit margins.
bullets: Engineered real-time predictive forecasting models designed to reduce food waste by an estimated 40% and combat $3B in annual industry operational losses.
Designed a scalable platform to reduce manual labor, eliminate human ordering errors, and protect venue profit margins.

title: Enterprise Wi-Fi Portal
summary: Real-time Wi-Fi dashboard for 2,000+ office users.
description: 1st Place, Process Improvement (Yazaki). A Wi-Fi reporting portal and real-time data-visualization dashboard that lets IT instantly locate and resolve network bottlenecks for 2,000+ office users.
bullets: Won 1st Place in Process Improvement for a Wi-Fi reporting portal and real-time data-visualization dashboard.
Enabled IT to instantly locate and resolve network bottlenecks for 2,000+ office users.

title: Automated Quotation Engine
summary: Parses specs to auto-calculate labor, cost & layout.
description: Automated quotation engine built at Yazaki by migrating legacy documents into a centralized database, then parsing customer specifications to precisely calculate labor, cost, and factory-layout requirements.
bullets: Migrated legacy documents into a centralized database to parse customer specifications.
Precisely calculated labor, cost, and factory-layout requirements from parsed specifications.

title: MoveRight
summary: Corrects your workout form in real time using AI.
description: AI fitness coach offering real-time exercise tracking and form correction from webcam input. Built a custom data-annotation tool and dataset of human exercises for more accurate models, integrating CV models (YOLOv8, ViTPose++) through FastAPI with a responsive React (Next.js) + Tailwind UI.
bullets: Worked as an AI specialist developing a vision mode offering real-time exercise tracking and form correction.
Created a custom data-annotation tool and dataset of human exercises for more accurate models.

title: AssembliSim
summary: Turns factory photos into live defect simulations.
description: Digital-twin factory simulation built for DevilsInvent Honeywell to optimize layouts and manufacturing processes and maximize machine + labor efficiency. Users scan existing factory environments via camera to create an interactive space for editing, modifying, and monitoring layout discrepancies in real time.
bullets: Developed a digital twin simulation for factories to optimize layouts and manufacturing processes, maximizing machine and labor efficiency.
Implemented camera scanning of existing factory environments, creating an interactive environment to edit, modify, and monitor layout discrepancies in real time.

title: Oratori
summary: A daily speaking companion powered by AI.
description: Unity2D daily speaking companion—users interact with an evolving, customizable companion to practice public speaking. Integrates speech-to-text processing and generative AI to retrieve curated, engaging responses and error feedback.
bullets: Users interact with an evolving, customizable companion daily with the goal of practicing public speaking.
Integrated speech-to-text processing and generative AI to retrieve curated, engaging responses and error feedback.

title: Fit2U
summary: Sustainable digital closet for a refreshed wardrobe.
description: Sustainable digital-closet ecosystem designed to refresh dull wardrobes and promote accessible fashion. Connects to local donation centers and other users and offers secondhand alternatives for any clothing item, with recommendations tailored to weather and preferences.
bullets: Created a local ecosystem designed to refresh dull wardrobes and promote sustainable, accessible fashion.
Connects to local donation centers and other users, offering secondhand alternatives for any clothing item.

title: V.I.B.E
summary: VR training for spotting aerospace defects.
description: Immersive VR training demonstration simulating real-world aerospace failures to train employees to spot dangerous scenarios. Fully interactive 3D models paired with a real-time accuracy assessment system that scores trainee performance.
bullets: Built an immersive VR training demonstration simulating real-world aerospace failures to train employees to spot dangerous scenarios.
Enabled fully interactive 3D models and integrated a real-time accuracy assessment system to score trainee performance.

title: SIR Model Visualizer
summary: Simulates pandemic spread under real interventions.
description: Science fair project (HISEF first place, AZSEF participant): simulated pandemic outcomes under different interventions using a custom Unity2D simulation.
bullets: Simulated pandemic outcomes under different interventions using a custom Unity2D simulation.
First place at HISEF; AZSEF participant.

title: MUD: Multi User Dungeon
summary: Text-based dungeon game with combat and progression.
description: Text-based dungeon game with interactable items, player progression, combat system, and randomly spawning mobs; collaborated via GitHub to implement a map system.
bullets: Built a text-based dungeon game with interactable items, player progression, combat, and randomly spawning mobs.
Collaborated via GitHub to implement a shared map system.
